source_anchor.evidence_boundary: Configuration-specific experiment: tested orthogonal pair was non-additive; tested horizontal/parallel pair superposed. Neither result is a universal array law.

experiment_hierarchy.purpose: Measure each cell's vector force, current, waveform, power and uncertainty independently under a common reference environment.
Measure pair force and compare it with the vector sum of matched isolated-cell baselines for controlled angle and spacing.
Test whether the local pairwise model predicts three-or-more-cell arrangements or whether higher-order interaction terms are material.
Measure cross-coupling under switched or duty-ratio commands, including transients and switching losses.
Hold out complete orientation/spacing families and an independent session to test transfer.

derived_metrics.additivity_residual_vector: r_ij = F_pair,measured - (F_i,isolated + F_j,isolated), for matched boundary conditions and common frame
derived_metrics.direction_error_deg: Angular difference between measured array resultant and vector sum prediction, with uncertainty near zero-force cases handled explicitly
derived_metrics.magnitude_relative_error: Relative error only where reference force magnitude is resolved above the declared detection threshold
derived_metrics.local_command_to_force_jacobian: J = d(F_x,F_y,F_z)/d(u_1,...,u_N) estimated locally around a declared operating point and envelope
derived_metrics.cross_coupling_ratio: A declared off-diagonal influence metric normalised to a declared diagonal reference; exact definition must be frozen before analysis
derived_metrics.matrix_condition_number: Condition number of the appropriately scaled local command-to-force Jacobian; report scaling and singular values
derived_metrics.higher_order_residual: Measured N-cell force less the prediction of the calibrated pairwise or local linear model

model_contract.model_form: F = f(u, geometry, gas_state, pressure, temperature, humidity, freestream, discharge_state)
model_contract.linearity_scope: A local linearization is valid only in an empirically identified envelope. It must not be extrapolated across corona onset/extinction, mode transitions, actuator saturation, materially changed flow topology, or geometry families without new qualification.

uncertainty_and_controls: calibrate balance and force-vector axes before and after randomized blocks
measure isolated-cell baselines in the same session and environmental block as paired runs
reverse orientation and polarity where apparatus permits
measure per-channel voltage and current waveforms rather than inferring them from supply setpoints
record lead, feedthrough, support, thermal, vibration and magnetic parasitic channels
randomize geometry/run order and replicate baseline configurations throughout the block
retain raw timestamps and do not interpolate away switching transients
preregister exclusion, outlier, holdout and multiple-comparison policies

holdout_requirements: at least one complete orientation family
at least one complete spacing family
at least one independent experimental session
proposed_acceptance_gates.linear_map_gate: Only use a local linearized map where held-out residuals, uncertainty calibration and conditioning stay within preregistered limits.
proposed_acceptance_gates.array_fault_gate: Demonstrate safe bounded force/attitude response after one cell is disabled or derated, within the separately qualified platform envelope.
proposed_acceptance_gates.switching_power_gate: Include per-channel switching, converter and terminal losses in wall-plug input power.

exclusion_rules: Do not assume isolated-cell force vectors superpose.
Do not infer a global coupling matrix from one voltage, spacing, orientation, gas state or session.
Do not train and test on neighbouring samples from the same geometry/session and call that geometry transfer.
Do not use a static force map as a transient switching model.
Do not compare bare-actuator force with an integrated platform result without matching system boundaries.
Do not mark a local linearization valid outside its empirically qualified envelope.
claim_ceiling: This benchmark specifies measurements, data fields and prospective gates only. No Luminous multi-anode force map, switching model, array controller, physical result, or SOTA improvement is claimed.
